box_rule: secondary only: symmetric coordinate widths equal maximum absolute adjacent complete revision per coordinate; continuous relaxation, not observed joint scenarios
contamination: all historical material treated as exposed development data; see exposure-correction.json
cost: L1 sum of weekly reported-death changes; no scaling or inferred probabilities
outcome_rule: latest path commit by reported Git committer timestamp <=2021-02-02T02:00:00Z, from currently accessible repository history; release-relative later-vintage comparison, not proof of first publication within 28 days
reporting: fixed original model identities; initial winner chosen once by MAE, later ties distinct from reversals; all results descriptive; no predictors, p-values or confidence intervals; retain null results
scenario_rule: adjacent retained pre-cutoff vintage differences on identical record keys, only complete vectors; add zero and deduplicate; apply unchanged same-key vectors to decision truth as a historical replay stress assumption, not a validated revision distribution
secondary_status: post-extraction common-support sensitivity check; not a replacement primary cohort or confirmatory result
